title: Singapore's Response to Refugee Situation in Rakhine State in Myanmar
what_it_is: Singapore's Response to Refugee Situation in Rakhine State in Myanmar

sections.label: ASEAN meeting on Rakhine State
sections.summary: On 19 December 2016, the speaker attended an ASEAN Foreign Ministers' informal meeting called by Myanmar's State Counsellor to brief on Rakhine State.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: On 19 December 2016, I attended an Association of Southeast Asian Nations' (ASEAN's) Foreign Ministers' informal meeting which was called by Myanmar's State Counsellor and Minister for Foreign Affairs Daw Aung San Suu Kyi to brief all of us on the situation in Rakhine State.

sections.label: Myanmar promises humanitarian access
sections.summary: After the meeting, Myanmar's government said it was ready to grant humanitarian access and keep ASEAN informed on Rakhine State developments.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Following the meeting, the Myanmar government expressed its readiness to grant necessary humanitarian access and to continue to keep ASEAN informed on developments in Rakhine state.

sections.label: Singapore fundraising for Rakhine State
sections.summary: Singapore communities raised over S$350,000 in December 2016, channelled through Myanmar-based organisations to all affected communities regardless of ethnicity and religion.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: In Singapore, our own local communities initiated a fundraising campaign in December 2016.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: I am very heartened to note that Singaporeans from across all communities have come forward to contribute more than S$350,000; I think it is closer to S$400,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The funds for the Rakhine state will be channelled through Myanmar-based organisations to assist all affected communities, regardless of ethnicity and religion.

sections.label: ASEAN trust fund and Singapore contribution
sections.summary: No decision was made on matching funds, but ASEAN established a trust fund for emergency relief, with Singapore contributing an initial US$200,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: These are issues which I would rather resolve on the ground by people who are actually present and familiar with the situation and familiar with the needs of the people.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: We have not made any decision on the matching funds but I would like to inform Members that the ASEAN countries have established a trust fund to support emergency humanitarian and relief efforts in the event of refugee flows within Southeast Asia.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The Singapore Government has made an initial contribution of US$200,000 to this trust fund and this trust fund is administered by the ASEAN Secretariat.

sections.label: Unresolved conflict as regional threat
sections.summary: The speaker lacks specific information on the case but states unresolved conflict in Southeast Asia poses an urgent threat and must be resolved at all levels.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: I do not have specific information on that particular case, nor am I in a position to advise on the security situation in the Rakhine state and whether there are any specific threats that that poses to us.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: However, I would state, as a general principle, that having any area in Southeast Asia where there is an unresolved, festering conflict, especially one that involves race, language or religion, poses an immediate and urgent threat to the country, but also to Southeast Asia as a whole.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: We hope that we will not end up with areas in Southeast Asia which act as a haven or act as a point where extremism, violence and terrorism can be fomented.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: That means we also need to resolve this at all levels: support the local authorities in resolving the local issues, ensure humanitarian access flows and also, to ensure that our operation and security agencies exchange necessary information and take the necessary precautions.
